facts.business: Regaal Resources Limited manufactures native and modified maize starch and derivatives, serving food and beverages, pharmaceuticals, paper, textiles, chemicals, adhesives, and animal feed industries.
key_risks: Maize price volatility due to weather variability and competing demand from animal feed and ethanol industries
Inability to fully pass on maize cost increases through product prices, particularly in commodity-grade starch
Regulatory non-compliances under Companies Act, 2013 with monetary penalties imposed on the company and its officers
Demand notice from State Tax Authority regarding alleged wrongful reimbursement
